def dct_coeffs(fn, n):
    theta = (np.arange(n) + 0.5) * np.pi / n        # equally spaced angles
    samples = fn(np.cos(theta))                     # f at the Chebyshev nodes
    k = np.arange(n)[:, None]
    a = 2 / n * np.cos(k * theta) @ samples         # DCT-II
    a[0] /= 2
    return a
